title: Notes Quizzer — Hard-code ActivePieces webhook URL and remove VITE_WEBHOOK_URL dependency (frontend-only)

requirements.summary: Default to a hard-coded ActivePieces webhook URL so the app works without VITE_WEBHOOK_URL, with documented override behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: If VITE_WEBHOOK_URL is not set at build time, uploads and Ask AI requests still call https://cloud.activepieces.com/api/v1/webhooks/arB5MIDx32mR1vdmBIC0r/sync
If VITE_WEBHOOK_URL is set, the app behavior is documented and consistent (either it overrides the hard-coded URL or it is ignored), and no runtime UI is required to configure it

file_operations.description: Introduce a hard-coded default webhook URL constant set to https://cloud.activepieces.com/api/v1/webhooks/arB5MIDx32mR1vdmBIC0r/sync and update getWebhookUrl() to return (1) VITE_WEBHOOK_URL when present (override) or (2) the hard-coded default when absent; update/rename hasWebhookUrl() semantics as needed so it no longer implies required env configuration.

Use the updated getWebhookUrl() resolution logic so uploadFile() and askAI() always target the hard-coded URL when VITE_WEBHOOK_URL is missing, while still allowing the documented env override behavior when it is set.
Update comments to clarify that VITE_WEBHOOK_URL is optional and only overrides the built-in default webhook URL (no longer required for the app to function).

Revise documentation to reflect the new default hard-coded webhook URL and the optional VITE_WEBHOOK_URL override behavior; remove instructions that suggest the app requires env configuration to function.

requirements.summary: Remove/disable any UI and project guidance that prompts users to configure VITE_WEBHOOK_URL or paste/save webhook URLs at runtime.
acceptanceCriteria: When the app loads in authenticated mode, there is no visible banner or alert telling the user to set VITE_WEBHOOK_URL
No UI flow exists that asks the user to paste/save/clear a webhook URL at runtime (e.g., via localStorage overrides or a setup panel)

file_operations.description: Remove/replace troubleshooting guidance that instructs users to use an in-app webhook setup panel or configure VITE_WEBHOOK_URL to fix a 'Webhook URL is not configured' issue; ensure the guide matches the new always-available hard-coded URL behavior.
Delete the unused Webhook setup/help panel placeholder to avoid any future UI prompts for configuring VITE_WEBHOOK_URL or runtime webhook setup.
Delete the unused webhook override placeholder to ensure there is no runtime/local override mechanism implied or later surfaced in the UI.

requirements.summary: Ensure upload and Ask AI flows do not fail with missing VITE_WEBHOOK_URL errors; show only real network/response failures.
acceptanceCriteria: With the hard-coded URL enabled, uploading a valid file does not throw an error about missing VITE_WEBHOOK_URL
With the hard-coded URL enabled, Ask AI does not throw an error about missing VITE_WEBHOOK_URL
If the webhook responds with non-OK status or invalid payload, the user sees a clear error describing the request/response failure (not env-var setup steps)

file_operations.description: Remove any explicit error branches/messages that reference missing VITE_WEBHOOK_URL; rely on the default URL resolution and keep errors focused on request failures (non-OK status) and response validation (invalid/missing fields).

Remove or repurpose configuration-specific exports (e.g., MISSING_WEBHOOK_ERROR) so no missing-env messaging is produced by shared helpers; ensure helpers cannot return null in normal operation given the hard-coded default.
